title: Repository with a UI and an API gets the same running-system breadth as a URL
context: The user gave repository access instead of a URL. The profile was built from code: a React frontend, an Express REST API with auth, Postgres, and a checkout component.

environments.name: local
evidence: started by the agent via npm run dev

reasoning_notes: Repository access must not shrink testing to the unit suite. The same signals a URL produces -- user-input from the API/UI, perf-baseline from a reachable API -- come out of a code-derived profile.
The locally started instance is declared non-production with the start command as evidence, which is what lets the running-system categories run against it.
